title: Stylish contemporary Estepona apartments with sea views
summary: Estepona is fast becoming one of hot spots of the Costa del Sol and the developers know it. Unique in maintaining its original Andalusian charm with its narrow white washed streets famous for their colourful geranium filled flower pots culminating in Flower Square, the town centre has kept its aesthetics with fairly low rise buildings, yet the main high street which runs parallel to the fantastic beach promenade, lined with trendy chiringuitos offering the many delights of Andalusian cuisine, is a bustling hive of activity. With a fast evolving infrastructure including modern hospitals, shopping centres and bustling Main Street it is giving Marbella a run for its money. Only 45 minutes’ drive from the international airports of Málaga and Gibraltar it’s no wonder so many choose this fantastic town to call their second home. The marina in Estepona is a favourite spot of many people who enjoy the buzzing night life and Marbella’s trendy Puerto Banus is only 20 minutes away.
